<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex035052026-11-1703-14-42" status="reviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">chos seng</rs> na re des na 'di ni 'dun pa spyi log yin te 'di ltar gzhan gsod mi sbyor ba brtsaMs nas ma shi'i go rol du bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa'i tshe bar du spang bya mtha' dag yong zhing gnyen
            po <lb n="26a7"/> mtha' dag blang snyaM pa 1 dgos ste | de myed na yan lag nges par song
            bas sdOm pa gtan myi skyed la | 'chi 'gyur gyi gang zag de yang ppang bya'i khongs su 'dus pa'i phyir ro || 
            'dun pa log pa sngar 'byed pa yang myi dgos te de ni ltung pa 'dag byed la dgos pa yin la 'dir btang pa yang ngo zhes bshad pas byed kyi bsaM pa rgyun chad <lb n="26a8"/> pa tsaM gyis chog pa'i phyir ro || </seg></TEI>
